segments.name: Model-specific home-energy controls
segments.thesis: Large heating/meter base creates compatibility/replacement jobs, but generic control retail is mature.
segments.supplier_gap: Generic controls don't address specific boiler/model compatibility

segments.name: Fast-growing EV exact-model cohorts
segments.thesis: Use DfT make/model stock to find cohorts growing faster than fitment specialists.
segments.supplier_gap: Generic EV accessories don't address specific vehicle/charger compatibility

segments.name: Plug-in solar post-regulation ecosystem
segments.thesis: New regulation creates demand shock but major retailers are entering immediately; monitor accessory/compatibility edge.
segments.supplier_gap: New regulation creating demand faster than retailers can stock compatible accessories

segments.name: Damp/thermal diagnostic commerce
segments.thesis: Large, geographically variable housing problems can create problem-led tool demand.
segments.supplier_gap: Generic tools don't address UK-specific damp/ventilation problems
